source_disagreement.resolution: Do not average. The sources have different exchange coverage, event times and contract/aggregation definitions; the two-venue Binance+Bybit sum is internally consistent at 09:00 UTC but does not validate the later five- or seven-venue totals.

Do not average. XRP Insights includes six spot funds plus BITW and has a November 4 settled holdings-delta row; CryptoKeyhole is partial on November 4 and reports a different November 3 universe; Alpha Finance covers five funds through November 3.
The Kraken ticker response is the direct venue observation in this artifact. Dynamic dashboards with older or unknown timestamps are not treated as simultaneous quotes.

competing_hypotheses.name: Intraday risk-off selloff with leveraged positioning pressure
supporting: Kraken price is 5.40% below the UTC daily open and 3.86% below its 24-hour VWAP
Price is only 0.55% above the 24-hour low
Earlier same-day dashboards showed long-account skews above 70% and positive funding
counterevidence: The long/short and OI observations are stale relative to the 19:00 UTC quote
Current Binance funding remains positive; this alone does not prove new long liquidation
No synchronized current multi-venue OI or liquidation feed was captured

competing_hypotheses.name: Broad risk-off and security-contagion repricing
supporting: Reuters reported bank supervisory outreach after the Binance incident
MarketWatch reported a sharp decline in an AI-focused ETF on November 5
counterevidence: Neither report establishes a causal XRP flow or price channel
A single sector ETF is not a broad-market benchmark
No synchronized macro factor regression is available

competing_hypotheses.name: ETF holdings outflows contribute to marginal spot supply
supporting: XRP Insights reports a three-session net holdings decrease of about 259,700 XRP
counterevidence: Flows are holdings deltas, not direct AP cash records
Other trackers have different fund universes and incomplete November 4 vintages
Magnitude is small relative to exchange turnover and does not establish causal price impact

competing_hypotheses.name: Venue and aggregation timing differences exaggerate apparent market disagreement
supporting: Direct Kraken and Binance observations are timestamped more precisely than third-party OI dashboards
OI values differ materially across two-, five- and seven-venue coverage
counterevidence: A genuine cross-venue market move can also produce short-lived basis differences
No synchronized raw order-book and trade tape was captured across venues

source_independence.rule: Publisher domains are not sufficient to establish independent underlying data. Exchange-derived dashboards may share Binance/Bybit APIs; ETF dashboards reuse issuer holdings files. Reuters, MarketWatch and BLS are separate publisher/primary-source groups, but their events do not automatically corroborate XRP price causality.

reasons: Kraken raw HTTP bytes and headers were not captured; only returned response text was hashed
Kraken provider event timestamp is absent from ticker response
Current multi-venue OI and order-book depth are not synchronized to the spot capture
Third-party OI aggregates disagree and some are stale or undated
ETF flows are holdings-derived with non-matching fund universes and incomplete November 4 coverage
No independent timestamp anchor or validated out-of-sample forecast evaluation is attached

forecast.reason: A single late-session spot snapshot and stale/conflicting derivatives/ETF aggregates do not establish a validated predictive edge. Preserve as an observation and competing-hypothesis record only.
